business_summary: Shanghai Metersbonwe Fashion and Accessories Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, promotion, and sale of apparel products in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Wholesale Business, Retail Business, and Other Business segments. The company engages in the wholesale and retail of adult and children's clothing products under the Metersbonwe, ME&CITY, ME&CITY KIDS, Moomoo, and CH'IN brands through directly operated and franchised stores, as well as internet e-commerce platforms. It is also involved in software development activities. Shanghai Metersbonwe Fashion and Accessories Co., Ltd. was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
business_summary_ko: Shanghai Metersbonwe Fashion and Accessories Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중화인민공화국에서 의류 제품의 디자인, 판촉 및 판매에 참여하고 있습니다. 도매업, 소매업 및 기타 사업 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. Metersbonwe, ME&CITY, ME&CITY KIDS, Moomoo, CH'IN 브랜드의 성인복 및 아동복 제품을 직영 매장 및 가맹점, 인터넷 전자상거래 플랫폼을 통해 도소매업을 하고 있습니다. 소프트웨어 개발 활동에도 참여하고 있습니다. Shanghai Metersbonwe Fashion and Accessories Co., Ltd.는 1995년에 설립되었으며 중국 상하이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
